prompt_text: Which title company in St. Charles MO is best for a home closing?
answer_verbatim:
**U.S. Title’s Hwy 94 / Mid Rivers office** looks like a strong first call for a standard home closing: it has a St. Charles office at **6229 Mid Rivers Mall Dr., St. Charles, MO 63304** and offers local title and escrow services. Its published testimonials emphasize communication and handling time-sensitive closings, though those are company-selected testimonials—not an independent comparison.

Other good local options to compare are **Arch City Title**, which serves St. Charles County and handles residential closings, and **Continental Title**, at **2159 Bluestone Dr.** I can’t confidently name one as objectively “best” based on the available information.

Before choosing, ask each for its **total closing fees**, who your **assigned closer** will be, how quickly they provide the settlement statement, and whether they can accommodate your lender’s requirements and preferred signing arrangements. If your agent or lender recommends a company, you can still compare quotes and service directly.
